name: kintone
summary: kintone and its customisations: a message shows as a bar at the top of the screen, one at a time, until it is closed, and the screen takes no operation while it loads.

evidence.source: cybozu developer network, kintone JavaScript API, 通知を表示する
evidence.says: A message at the top of the screen is one of three types (error, success, information), stays until it is closed, and shows one at a time: the last one called replaces the others.

evidence.source: cybozu developer network, kintone JavaScript API, ローディングを表示する
evidence.says: While the loading indicator is shown, the user cannot operate the screen.
